17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans — 446 North Aberdeen Street, Chicago, IL

Proposed Zoning: RM-4.5 Residential Multi-Unit District
Lot Area: Approximately 2,745 sq. ft.

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is proposing to legally establish the existing three and a half-
story residential building and detached garage. The residential building will
continue to contain three (3) dwelling units and be supported by three (3)
off-street parking spaces. The 37 ft.-0.75 in. height and footprint of the
existing residential building will remain without change. The subject
property is a Transit Served Location (TSL). Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-0303-
D optional Administrative Adjustment and Variation and pursuant to Secs.
17-13-1003-EE, 17-13-1003-K, and 17-13-1101-B of the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, the Applicant is seeking to increase the off-street parking ratio
from 66.66% (2 parking spaces) to 100% (3 parking spaces), reduce the rear
yard open space to zero, reduce the front setback to 2.19 ft., reduce the
combined side setback to 2.62 ft., and is seeking all zoning relief, as needed
and as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, for the attached plans.

(A) _ The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 4,544 square feet (1.66 FAR)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): 294.64 square feet per D.U.
(3 units total)

(C) The amount of off-street parking: 3 parking spaces

*The subject property is a designated Transit Served Location based on its
proximity to the CTA Blue Line Grand Station. Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1003-EE,
the Applicant is seeking to increase the off-street parking ratio from 66.66% (2
parking spaces) to 100% (3 parking spaces).

() — Setbacks:
a. Front Setback: 2.91 feet
b. Side Setbacks:
North Side: 0 inches
South Side: 2.62 inches
c. Rear Setback: 43 feet-8.75 inches

*Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1101-B, the Applicant is seeking to reduce the front
setback to 2.91 ft. and reduce the combined side setback to 2.62 ft.

(E) Building Height: 37 feet-0.75 inches
